field.name: ownerPartyId
field.description: If applicable, such as for customer records, the other Party that 'owns' the data for this Party.

field.name: privateOwnerUserId
field.description: For a personal contact, the user it belongs to: only that user sees the party (the MANTLE_USER_ORG and MANTLE_ACTIVE_ORG entity filters, and the party finds, searches, lookups and duplicate services). Empty for a directory party; cleared when the contact is linked to the directory.

field.name: storedValue
field.description: For RFID this is the unique tracking identifier (the TID can be tracked in the serialNumber field)

entity.description: A party's consent, granted or withdrawn, for a purpose (marketing email, SMS, phone, data processing): for one of its addresses (contactMechId) or the party as a whole (none), and for a list subscription change (contactListId), with when, how (sourceEnumId), the evidence and who recorded it. History only: each change is a new row and rows are not updated. The current state of a purpose for an address (or for the party, with no contactMechId) is its latest row without a contactListId, by consentDate; a row with a contactListId is the history of that list's subscription, whose state is the ContactListParty status. Whether an address may be solicited is PartyContactMech.allowSolicitation, which mantle.party.ConsentServices.store#PartyConsent keeps in step with the marketing purposes of the address.

field.name: evidenceText
field.description: What shows the consent or its withdrawal: the form and its wording, the import file, the message whose link was used

field.name: contactListId
field.description: Set on a list subscription change

field.name: userId
field.description: The user who recorded it; empty for the anonymous unsubscribe page

field.name: originalPartyContentId
field.description: Set this when copying content from one Party to another, may have same or different contentLocation

moqui.basic.Enumeration.description: Economic Operator Registration and Identification Code - EORI Number
Registration Number of the Professional Roll

entity.description: A decision that two parties are not duplicates (mantle.party.DuplicateServices mark#PartyNotDuplicate and unmark#PartyNotDuplicate). The duplicate services leave the pair out: find#PartyDuplicates, find#PartyHasDuplicates, find#PartyNameMatches and so the check#AllPartyDuplicates scan. One row per pair either way round: partyId is the lower id of the two and otherPartyId the higher, so a party's decisions are the rows with its id in either field. merge#Parties moves the merged party's decisions to the party it is merged into.

field.name: relationshipName
field.description: Official name of relationship, such as title in an organization.

relationship.description: This is one-nofk because settingValue may by an enumId or may be plain text depending on PartySettingType
This is one-nofk because settingValue may by an enumId or may be plain text depending on PartySettingType

field.name: validRegexp
field.description: For non-enum settings, regexp to validate

field.name: templateAgreementId
field.description: The template agreement this agreement was cloned from

entity.description: For price lists associated with an AgreementItem use the ProducePrice entity.

field.name: editedDate
field.description: When its author last changed the text of a note or comment after posting it (mantle.party.CommunicationServices.update#RecordNote, mantle.request.RequestServices.update#RequestComment); empty for one never changed. A timeline shows it as edited.

field.name: readDate
field.description: Empty is unread

field.name: snoozedThruDate
field.description: Hidden from the Inbox until this date

entity.description: A label one party put on one internal message (CommunicationEvent). The label is an EmailLabel of that party's Internal email account, so two people on the same message label it apart. A thread shows a label when any of its messages has it for that party. Internal messages have no folders.

The line of a merge request's diff a review comment is on (MR Moqui, no Java counterpart): the comment is a CommunicationEvent of type Comment filed on the merge request (CommunicationEventRecord with recordEntityName moqui.resource.GitMergeRequest), its replies children of it (parentCommEventId, rootCommEventId); the first comment of a thread holds the anchor and its status CeResolved when the thread is resolved (mantle.work.GitServices.store#ReviewAnchor, resolve#ReviewThread). commitId is the source head the line was read at; outdated is Y once a later head changed the line (refresh#ReviewAnchors).

field.name: oldLine
field.description: The line in the target side; empty for an added line

field.name: newLine
field.description: The line in the source side; empty for a deleted line

field.name: lineText
field.description: The line as it was, for an outdated thread

entity.description: A communication event filed on any record, by the record's full entity name and the value of its single primary key field, for a record type without a join of its own. The own joins (OrderCommunicationEvent, RequestCommEvent, WorkEffortCommEvent, WikiPageCommunicationEvent) stay, and a party's link is the event's from and to party and its CommunicationEventParty rows; mantle.party.CommunicationServices.link#CommunicationEventRecord chooses.

field.name: recordUrl
field.description: The record's screen, for the follower notification's link

entity.description: A user following a record (its full entity name and single primary key value), and which kinds of activity on it notify the user: messages, notes, activities and changes. Unfollowing deletes the row.

A named collection of parties: a user's personal book (ownerUserId, visibility CbvPersonal) or a shared book (visibility CbvShared, ownerPartyId the organization it belongs to, if any) that ContactBookShare rows open to users and user groups. A personal contact (Party.privateOwnerUserId set) goes only in its owner's personal books. The members are ContactBookParty rows; groups (labels) inside the book are ContactBookGroup. mantle.party.ContactBookServices checks access: the owner manages a personal book, shares give view, edit or manage on a shared one.

field.name: color
field.description: The book's color, a CSS color such as #1e88e5

field.name: ownerUserId
field.description: The user a personal book belongs to

field.name: ownerPartyId
field.description: The organization a shared book belongs to

field.name: isDefault
field.description: Y on the user's default personal book, where new personal contacts go

entity.description: A group (label) inside a contact book; a party may be in any number of its book's groups.
A party in a contact book group. A label is on or off, so removing it deletes the row; fromDate is when it was added.
A party in a contact book, from fromDate until thruDate (removing it sets thruDate); isFavorite stars it in that book.

field.name: davName
field.description: The resource name a CardDAV client stored the card under (mantle.party.ContactDavServices), when it is not partyId.vcf

field.name: davUid
field.description: The card's UID as the client wrote it, which the vCard served for this book keeps

entity.description: A shared contact book opened to a user (userId) or a user group (userGroupId) with a permission: view (read and export), edit (members, groups and favorites) or manage (the book itself and its shares). Unsharing sets thruDate.

field.name: paymentFraudEvidenceId
field.description: Refer to evidence here if trustLevelEnumId is gray listed or black listed

field.name: replacesContactMechId
field.description: For update by copy-on-write this is the ID of the ContactMech it replaces

entity.description: For configurable time periods used in accounting, sales quotas, etc.

field.name: partyId
field.description: The Party that owns the TimePeriod, generally an Internal Organization.

field.name: fromDate
field.description: The first day of the period.

field.name: thruDate
field.description: The last day of the period.
